test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 12 July 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

I like eating chocolates, ________ I hate dark ones.
solution:
The correct answer is **but**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **But **is used to link items which are the same grammatical type (**coordinating conjunction**).
 
• But is used to **connect ideas that contrast**.
 
• Thus, the most appropriate option to fill in the blank is **option 2**. 

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **For:** used to talk about a purpose or a reason for something.
 
• **Because:** for the reason that. क्‍योंकि
 
• **While: **during the time that; when. उस समय जब; जब
